summary.text: Brian Duggan is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 16, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Stephanie Young.
He was also the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Brian Duggan advanced from the Republican primary for District 16 on August 6, 2024, receiving 2,043 votes in an uncontested race.

In the November 5, 2024 general election, he received 10,803 votes (22.3 percent) to incumbent Stephanie Young's 35,682 (73.5 percent), with Working Class Party candidate Linda Green-Harris receiving 2,050.
Duggan advanced from the 2026 Republican primary for District 16 on August 4, 2026, receiving 3,149 votes in an uncontested race.
Ballotpedia lists him as a signer of the U.S. Term Limits Pledge.
